text: ADR-005 sets the application id / package namespace to app.wlo (packages app.wlo.*, deep links wlo://). This is a mechanical change until the first Play Store upload and expensive after. Confirm app.wlo as final, or propose an alternative (e.g. a reverse-domain you own). Work proceeds on app.wlo meanwhile.

src:
## Acceptance criteria
1. App installs and launches on the API 29 AVD; five placeholder tabs navigate;
   `wlo://hub` deep link resolves.
2. CI is green and fails deliberately on: feature→network dep, Android import in
   commonMain, INTERNET outside `:app`, derived number rendered without chip (lint demo).
3. Room schema export + one example migration test pass; JVM purity target compiles.
4. A dummy `DerivedValue` renders through the provenance chip end-to-end.
text:
**M1 implementation complete — 2026-09-12.** All four acceptance criteria verified on this machine (macOS/arm64, JDK 21, API 29 AVD `wlo-api29`):

1. **Launch + nav + deep link** — debug APK installs and launches on the API 29 emulator; five tabs (Hub · Plan · Insights · Archive · Digestion) navigate; `wlo://hub` / `wlo://digestion` deep links resolve incl. singleTask re-delivery. `:app:connectedDebugAndroidTest`: 7/7 green. Screenshots reviewed: dark-first theme, Inter + tnum, provenance chips render measured/derived/held correctly.
2. **Deliberate-failure checks** — `checkArchitecture` (D1/D2 graph edges, D3 commonMain import scan, D4 manifest INTERNET grep + merged-manifest scan, D6 rendering tripwire, D7 engine-purity scan) with 7 Gradle TestKit self-tests proving each rule fails on a synthetic violation + clean control (`./gradlew -p build-logic test` green). CI workflow wired (build+arch / arch-selftest / instrumented on API 29) — green locally; GitHub run pending first push.
3. **Room 3 schema + migration** — schema 1.json & 2.json exported and committed; JVM `MigrationTest` (room3-testing + BundledSQLiteDriver) migrates v1→v2 and validates schema+data; 34 JVM unit tests green across core modules.
4. **DerivedValue → provenance chip end-to-end** — Hub renders dummy measured/derived/held `DerivedValue`s through the only DerivedValue-accepting components (`WloStat`/`ProvenanceChip`); type-level D6 (no String overload) + grep tripwire live.

Stack verified against registry metadata (Room 3.0.3 androidx.room3, Kotlin 2.4.20, KSP 2.3.12 new plain scheme, AGP 9.4.0, Gradle wrapper 9.7.1, Compose BOM 2026.09.00). App id = `app.wlo` per ADR-005; q-000027 asks the owner to confirm (mechanical to change before first Play upload). No INTERNET permission anywhere in M1 (verified: 0 of 3 merged manifests).
